[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on completing the HubSpot digital marketing course! That's a great step towards enhancing your digital skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended social media analytics tools include: Hootsuite Insights, Google Analytics, Sprout Social, Buffer Analyze, Agorapulse, Facebook Insights, Twitter Analytics, Brand24, Union Metrics, and Cyfe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite Insights is a built-in analytics tool within Hootsuite's social media management platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Analytics is a powerful web analytics tool that can also track social media traffic and conversions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social is an all-in-one social media management platform that includes analytics, engagement, and publishing features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Buffer Analyze provides in-depth insights into social media performance, including engagement rates, reach, and content types.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Agorapulse offers customizable dashboards and detailed reports on engagement, audience growth, and content performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Facebook Insights is a free analytics tool for page administrators, providing insights into page performance, engagement, and audience demographics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Twitter Analytics is a free tool for account holders, offering insights into tweet performance, engagement, and audience demographics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Brand24 tracks mentions, sentiment, and analytics across multiple platforms, useful for tracking brand reputation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Union Metrics provides detailed insights into engagement, audience growth, and content performance on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cyfe is a business intelligence platform that offers social media analytics along with website analytics, sales, and marketing metrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing a tool include the social media platforms you're active on, the type of analytics needed, budget, and level of customization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite pricing plans: Professional ($19/month), Team ($49/month), Business ($129/month), Enterprise (custom pricing).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social pricing plans: Standard ($99/month), Pro ($149/month), Advanced ($249/month), Enterprise (custom pricing).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both Hootsuite and Sprout Social offer free trials.  
[USER] User is especially interested in Hootsuite Insights and Sprout Social.
